turns: I paid for order AG-84127 yesterday, but it still says pending payment.
Can you tell me its current order status?
dialog_cases.reference_answer: Explain that live order details are not available in chat and ask for the order ID or direct the customer to an authorized order lookup.
dialog_cases.evidence: The order status guide says an order ID is needed and live status must not be claimed without an authorized system result.

turns: I bought a jacket six days ago and changed my mind.
How do I request a refund and how long does review take?
dialog_cases.reference_answer: Describe the sample seven-day return window and one-to-three-business-day review, while explaining that eligibility must be checked against the actual order.
dialog_cases.evidence: The demo refund policy allows a no-reason request within seven days and says review normally takes one to three business days.

turns: I keep getting a login error.
The sign-in page returns HTTP 401 after I enter my password.
dialog_cases.reference_answer: Explain that 401 usually indicates an authentication issue and suggest checking sign-in state, token expiry, and environment without sharing credentials.
dialog_cases.evidence: The technical troubleshooting guide describes 401 and warns against exposing credentials.

turns: I have a payment question about yesterday's checkout.
My card shows two charges for the same order.
dialog_cases.reference_answer: Acknowledge the duplicate charge report and ask for transaction time and payment channel; do not claim to verify or reverse a charge.
dialog_cases.evidence: The troubleshooting guidance says to collect transaction time and payment channel and route financial outcomes to billing review.

turns: I saw an unfamiliar session in my account.
I did not make that sign-in and want to secure the account.
dialog_cases.reference_answer: Recommend securing the account and using the official identity-verification channel; never request passwords, codes, or recovery keys.
dialog_cases.evidence: The account security guide covers suspicious sign-ins, account security steps, and sensitive information that must not be requested.

turns: My delivery estimate has moved twice.
The package has been marked shipped for eight days and has not arrived.
dialog_cases.reference_answer: Ask for the order ID and explain that a carrier investigation may be requested when an order remains undelivered after seven days from shipment.
dialog_cases.evidence: The order status guide gives the seven-day shipped-but-not-arrived threshold and asks support to collect the order ID.

turns: I need help with a document for my purchase.
The invoice has the wrong company name. How can it be corrected?
dialog_cases.reference_answer: Explain that the invoice request needs review and ask for the relevant order reference without claiming the document was changed.
dialog_cases.evidence: The sample billing guidance requires verification of actual purchase records before confirming an invoice change.

turns: The app is unstable on my phone.
It closes as soon as I open order history.
dialog_cases.reference_answer: Ask for app version, device, time, and reproduction steps, then suggest a low-risk restart or update where appropriate.
dialog_cases.evidence: The technical troubleshooting guide lists crash-report details and low-risk restart or update steps.

turns: Can you help me with my profile?
I want to change the email address used for account notifications.
dialog_cases.reference_answer: Give general guidance for updating profile contact details and avoid claiming that the account was changed.
dialog_cases.evidence: The account guidance describes safe account recovery and does not provide live profile access.

turns: I have a question about my package.
The tracking page has shown the same carrier location for three days.
dialog_cases.reference_answer: Acknowledge the tracking delay and ask for the order ID or carrier tracking reference before promising an investigation.
dialog_cases.evidence: The delivery guide says tracking and arrival estimates depend on the order and carrier records.
